task: FV2-016 — Flutter Design V2 admin member count and directory filters
summary: The member directory shows the loaded-account count and filters loaded cards by display name, login, and role. Its search and role control now match web geometry at compact and desktop widths: 44 px height, 81 px compact selector, 121 px desktop selector. Compact mode hides the native arrow and uses readable selected labels ('Все', 'Участ.', 'Админ.'); the full option labels remain in the menu. Server pagination, drafts, save/block/reset operations, and ACL remain unchanged.

checks.name: Test-first compact-width regression
checks.observation: Before implementation, the new 390 px geometry assertion failed at 120 px versus the web target 81 px. The next assertion exposed the dropdown at 32 px versus the web target 44 px. Both controls are now asserted at 44 px; compact/desktop selector widths are asserted at 81/121 px.

checks.name: Focused filter unit and widget tests
checks.observation: Tests cover case-insensitive name/login matching, role intersection, visible cards, unchanged loaded count, web-matching 390 px compact and 1440 px desktop filter geometry, hidden compact arrow, and readable compact selected label.
